text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Curren Bouquetd'or is kind.
Come to think of it, wherever she went, she was always empathizing with others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why I want today to just be a day 'for her.' To make that happen, I put together a plan—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—A flower exhibition... It sounds lovely.
Flowers of all kinds from all over the world, gathered in one place—
choice_data_list: Glad you're looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Of course, that is part of it, but—
............

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Your kindness...
makes me so happy, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we get going—
...Oh?

text_block_list.name: Lost Girl
text_block_list.text: M-Mom...! W-Where are you...!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Looks like she's lost.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's okay... You'll see your mother soon.
Let's go to the police box... together, all right?
choice_data_list: Is there a police box around here...? Let me look it up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, she was safely reunited with her mother, resolving the issue—
but even after that...

text_block_list.name: Fallen Man
text_block_list.text: O-Ow, ow, ow, ow, ow...!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
! It looks like that person fell down the stairs—
Oh no, we have to go help them right away...!
choice_data_list: I'll go call an ambulance!
I'll call an ambulance just in case!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear me... My grandchild's apartment
should be right around here, though...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... The roads around here are quite intricate.
If you'd like—shall I help you
look for them?
choice_data_list: Do you know your grandchild's address?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way, we ran into some people in deep trouble—

text_block_list.name: Pale-Faced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Ack, my battery died!?
Oh no, I don't know this area at all...!
Which way's the station...?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, how awful...! Let me guide—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...The exhibition hours—
I believe it's almost closing time...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even though you went out of your way to invite me...
...at this rate...―
choice_data_list: More importantly, it's about what you want to do!
More importantly, it's about what you want to do!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I want to help... them. That person.
choice_data_list: Then I want to do the same!
Then, I want to do that too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
In the end—we didn't make it in time for the exhibition, did we?"
choice_data_list: Still, we managed to save them properly, didn't we?
Still, we managed to save them properly, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
But... after all the trouble you went through to plan it,
I ended up ruining everything...
choice_data_list: ...No. Actually, I have one more thing prepared.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san...!
This is—
choice_data_list: A flower arrangement. It's... handmade, just so you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made it by copying her mother, who said she used to make flower crowns for her.
...Regardless of how well it turned out.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Why... do you do so much for me...?
choice_data_list: ...Why, you ask? ...Well—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She's kind. Infinitely so,
as if her kindness has no bottom."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, I know now that this kindness was shaped and supported by the kindness of those around me. That is why—
choice_data_list: I want to be one of those 'kind people' too.
I want to be one of those "kind people" too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kindness should be met with kindness. If I could play even the smallest part in bringing harmony to her heart—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: As a token of my feelings... this might be a bit clumsy, though...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That's—not true at all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Right now... I feel so warm inside.
It feels as though the kindness you gave me
is filling up my entire body—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "It feels as though a landscape of harmony is spreading endlessly across my soul..."
choice_data_list: Someday I want to give you an even greater gift, but...
I'm glad your feelings got through to them!
Thanks to you, maybe I can learn to be kinder too.
Thanks to you, maybe I can learn to be kinder too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "It feels as though a landscape of harmony is spreading endlessly across my soul..."
choice_data_list: Someday I want to give you an even greater gift, but...
I'm glad your feelings got through to them!
Thanks to you, maybe I can learn to be kinder too.
Thanks to you, maybe I can learn to be kinder too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...I appreciate the thought. But—
it doesn't matter whether it's admirable or not.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: The feelings poured into it... will never fade away, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
............
I have always――received far more than I deserve from you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—you are the one
who brings harmony to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. What strange things
you say.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
From the very beginning... you always have.
Trainer, you have always been such a kind person.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In the past, and from now on as well...
I've always noticed, you know.
